race.title: William Hill Challenge Series Handicap Chase
race.verdict: IAMAGETAWAY showed improved form to get off the mark over fences at Downpatrick 41 days ago and looks capable of defying an 8 lb rise back in handicap company. Hees Dynamite is well handicapped on his hurdling form and is feared most, while That's About Right and Doctor Confusion are also respected. IAMAGETAWAY (IRE) HEES DYNAMITE (IRE) THAT'S ABOUT RIGHT (IRE)
race.bettingForecast: Iamagetaway (7/2), Doctor Confusion (4/1), Smallcraftwarning (8/1), Hees Dynamite (8/1), Labondance (10/1), That's About Right (10/1), Giant Haystacks (10/1), Roc My Haarth (10/1), Schiehallion (14/1), Wing Back (14/1), Dundaniel (14/1), Gatsby Grey (16/1), Brother Hollie (20/1), Toor Khov (20/1), Clonbury Bridge (33/1)
